agg.help:
Detect cell-type aggregates (e.g. TLS) and write namespaced outputs.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      model-outputs-csv/<slide>.csv      gains object_<name>_prob_<name> column
      agg-<name>-outputs-csv/<slide>.csv  one row per aggregate (hplot-consumable)
      graphs/<slide>.h5                   gains an agg/<name>/ quotient-graph group
agg.name: agg

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during agg.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Product label for this aggregate (lower-case [a-z0-9_]+), e.g. 'tls'.  Namespaces every artifact (object_<name>_prob_<name> column, agg-<name>-outputs-csv/, agg/<name>/ in the graph cache) and is usable as a type in `wsinsight hplot --target-by aggregate`.
params.name: agg_name

params.help: Comma-separated ingredient cell types that may join the aggregate, e.g. 't_cell,b_cell'.
params.name: agg_types

params.help: Maximum distance (µm) between neighboring cells in the Delaunay graph.
params.name: agg_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: k-hop neighborhood radius for the density gate.
params.name: agg_k

params.help: Minimum neighborhood size for a cell to be inside an aggregate region.
params.name: agg_n

params.help: Minimum fraction of ingredient cells in the neighborhood (density gate).
params.name: agg_r

params.help: Drop aggregates with fewer than this many cells.
params.name: agg_min_size

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide agg outputs for this name.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

cme.help:
Discover cellular microenvironments (CMEs) across a cohort of slides.

    Builds per-slide Delaunay cell graphs, trains a global Deep Graph Infomax
    (DGI) encoder across all slides, clusters the resulting embeddings, and
    writes per-cell CME labels and annotation-level region merges.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      cme-outputs-csv/cells/<slide>.csv   per-cell CME labels + features
      cme-outputs-csv/cmes/<slide>.csv    annotation-level merged CME regions
      cme-outputs-geojson/cells/          GeoJSON cell detections with CME labels
      cme-outputs-geojson/cmes/           GeoJSON CME region annotations
cme.name: cme

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used for slide enumeration and um-per-pixel resolution; images are read only when --cme-hoptimus is set.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a model-outputs-csv/ subdirectory produced by wsinsight infer or wsinsight run.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Enable H-Optimus tissue morphology features in addition to k-hop cell-type composition.  Requires a GPU and the timm package.
params.name: cme_hoptimus

params.help: Number of microenvironment clusters (KMeans).  When omitted, the optimal number is determined automatically via a Leiden community-detection sweep.
params.name: cme_clusters

params.help: Delete cached checkpoints and recompute all CME outputs from scratch.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of workers for GeoJSON export at the end of the run.
params.name: num_workers

cme-profile.help: Summarise each CME's cell composition (and marker genes, if any) to help name niches.
cme-profile.name: cme-profile

params.help: Results directory containing cme-outputs-csv/cells/ from `wsinsight cme`.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Number of top enriched marker genes to report per CME (if expr_ columns exist).
params.name: top_genes

params.help: Number of top cell types to summarise per CME.
params.name: top_types

ecomp.help:
Compute edge-level neighborhood composition for WSInsight inference outputs.

    For every Delaunay edge (two cells connected in the triangulation), the
    k-hop neighboring edges are collected from the line graph and the
    proportion of each edge type in that neighborhood is recorded.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      ecomp-outputs-csv/<slide_id>.csv   per-edge neighborhood composition
ecomp.name: ecomp

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and to resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during ecomp.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Maximum Delaunay edge length (µm); longer edges are pruned before building the line graph.
params.name: ecomp_max_edge

params.help: Number of hops that define the edge-level neighborhood radius (k-hop on the line graph).
params.name: ecomp_k

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide ecomp outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Skip line-graph construction and k-hop aggregation.  Output one row per Delaunay edge with geometry, cell types, edge type, and a ``center_region`` column (derived from per-vertex ``region_prob_*`` columns).  Much faster; no ``neighborhood_*`` columns are written.
params.name: no_neighborhood

export.help:
Merge all available per-cell analytics and export to GeoJSON / OME-CSV.

    Reads whatever analysis outputs are present under RESULTS_DIR:

     
      model-outputs-csv/       — base inference probabilities (+ reg columns)
      hplot-outputs-csv/cells/ — H-Plot per-cell layer features
      ncomp-outputs-csv/       — node-level (cell) composition features

    All per-cell sources above are left-joined into export-csv/, then
    written to export-geojson/ and/or export-omecsv/ depending on the
    flags provided.

    Edge-level (``ecomp-outputs-csv/``) and triad-level
    (``tcomp-outputs-csv/``) composition outputs are standalone
    simplicial deliverables and are NOT merged into the per-cell
    export (they have different primary keys).  Consume them
    directly from their respective subdirectories.

    At least one of --geojson or --omecsv must be supplied.

    This command can be run at any time after inference — and optionally after
    hplot / ncomp — without re-running the full inference pipeline.
export.name: export

params.help: Results directory produced by a prior wsinsight run / infer / hplot / ncomp invocation.  Must contain a model-outputs-csv/ subfolder.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Export per-cell data to GeoJSON files (export-geojson/).
params.name: geojson

params.help: Export per-cell data to compressed OME-CSV files (export-omecsv/).  Compatible with QuPath and OMERO+.
params.name: omecsv

params.help: Overlap ratio used during inference (must match the original run). Controls the tile-box shrinkage written into each exported feature.
params.name: patch_overlap_ratio

params.help: QuPath object-type label embedded in each exported GeoJSON / OME-CSV feature.
params.name: object_type

params.help: Worker processes used for parallel GeoJSON / OME-CSV serialisation.
params.name: export_workers

params.help: Re-build export CSVs even when export-csv/ already contains up-to-date files.  Useful after re-running hplot or ncomp.
params.name: overwrite

hplot.help: Run H-Plot analysis on inference outputs held inside ``results_dir``.
hplot.name: hplot

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images. This directory can *only* contain whole slide images.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.name: hplot_base_types

params.name: hplot_target_types

params.name: target_by

params.help: The maximal edge distance for defining the neighborhood of a cell.

params.help: The minimal neighborhood size for a cell to be computed for determining tumor regions.
params.name: hplot_n

params.help: The minimal ratio of tumor cells in the neighborhood of a cell, determining is this cell included in a tumor region.
params.name: hplot_r

params.help: The maximal layer index toward OUTSIDE of tumors for the range window of H-Plot.
params.name: hplot_range_max

params.help: The minimal layer index toward INSIDE of tumors for the range window of H-Plot.

params.help: Overwrite existing H-Plot results instead of skipping slides that already have outputs.

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.

hplot-finalize.help:
Rebuild hplot-outputs.csv from per-slide intermediates.

    Use this after running parallel ``hplot`` jobs that share the same
    ``--results-dir``. Each worker writes its per-slide files; this command
    assembles the final aggregated CSV from all of them.
hplot-finalize.name: hplot-finalize

params.help: Results directory containing hplot per-slide outputs. The aggregated hplot-outputs.csv will be written here.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Overwrite existing hplot-outputs.csv if it already exists.
params.name: overwrite

infer.help:
Execute WSInsight inference and optional post-processing on prepared patches.

    The command consumes an existing `results_dir` (typically produced by `wsinsight
    patch` or `wsinsight run`) that already contains patch-level HDF5 data whose
    metadata enumerates the processed slides. Depending on the arguments, it either
    loads a registered model,
    a custom config/model-path pair, or synthesizes a pseudo-model from QuPath
    detections/annotations. After validating the requested patch geometry, the
    selected model is run via `run_inference`, producing CSV outputs under
    `model-outputs-csv`.

    Optional switches then:
        • synchronize metadata about the full session to `infer_metadata_*.json`.

    Use ``wsinsight export`` to convert results to GeoJSON / OME-CSV.
    Use ``wsinsight hplot`` / ``wsinsight ncomp`` for downstream spatial analytics.

    The function treats all input/output paths as `URIPath` values, materializing
    local copies only when dependencies such as pandas/geopandas require filesystem
    paths. Usage mirrors the CLI: `wsinsight infer --results-dir ... [options]`.
infer.name: infer

params.help: Optional directory containing whole slide images; inferred patches remain the primary input.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Hidden argument for orchestrators to pass explicit slide paths alongside cached patches.
params.name: slide_paths

params.help: Directory to store results. If directory exists, will skip whole slides for which outputs exist.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior region-level (patch-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder. Requires --object-based: each detected object is matched to its enclosing region and the region's class probabilities are added as region_prob_* columns in the output.
params.name: region_inference_dir

params.help: Directory of QuPath TSV detection-measurement exports (one <slide>.txt per slide containing 'Centroid X µm', 'Centroid Y µm', classification columns). Patches are extracted as fixed-size squares centered on each centroid. For GeoJSON detection exports, use --qupath-geojson-detection-dir instead.
params.name: qupath_measurement_detection_dir

params.name: qupath_geojson_annotation_dir

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath detection files.
params.name: qupath_detection_patch_size

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation files.
params.name: qupath_annotation_patch_size

params.help: The spacing um/px of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation/detection files.
params.name: qupath_spacing_um_px

params.help: Use QuPath 'name' fields as classes instead of the default Classification column when ingesting detection/annotation data.
params.name: qupath_name_as_class

params.help: Name of the model to use from WSInsight Model Zoo. Mutually exclusive with --config.
params.name: model_name

params.help: Path to configuration for the trained model. Use this option if the model weights are not registered in wsinsight. Mutually exclusive with--model
params.name: config

params.help: Path to the pretrained model. Use only when --config is passed. Mutually exclusive with --model.
params.name: model_path

params.help: Path to a folder containing config.json and torchscript_model.pt. Shorthand for --config + --model-path. Mutually exclusive with --model, --config, and --model-path.
params.name: zoo_model_dir

params.help: Batch size during model inference. If using multiple GPUs, increase the batch size.
params.name: batch_size

params.help: Dataloader workers that feed patches to PyTorch (n=0 runs single-threaded). Default heuristics use min(2 × GPU count, CPU count).
params.name: num_workers

params.help: The ratio of overlap among patches. The default value of 0 produces non-overlapping patches. A value in (0, 1) will produce overlapping patches. Negative values will add space between patches. A value of -1 would skip every other patch. A value of 0.5 will provide 50%% of overlap between patches. Values must be in (-inf, 1).

params.help: The size of patch in um. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.

params.help: The size of patch in pixel. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_px

params.help: Overwrite existing outputs instead of skipping slides that already have results.  Currently controls region_* column replacement when --region-inference-dir is used.

ncomp.help:
Compute neighborhood composition for each cell in WSInsight inference outputs.

    For every cell (cell type determined by the highest ``prob_*`` score),
    the k-hop Delaunay graph neighbors are collected and the proportion of each
    cell type in that neighborhood is recorded.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      ncomp-outputs-csv/<slide_id>.csv   per-cell neighborhood composition
ncomp.name: ncomp

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and to resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during ncomp.

params.name: results_dir

params.help: Maximum distance (µm) between neighboring cells in the Delaunay graph.
params.name: ncomp_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: Number of hops that define the neighborhood radius (k-hop).
params.name: ncomp_k

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide ncomp outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

reg.help:
Register a primary object-CSV against a secondary inference.

    The secondary inference may be a region-level run (``-r``) or another
    object-level run (``-c``); exactly one must be supplied.  Region matching
    uses point-in-bbox containment; object matching uses nearest-neighbour
    KD-tree lookup within ``--radius-um``.  Matched secondary class
    probabilities are appended in-place to the primary CSVs under
    ``region_<tag>_prob_*`` or ``object_<tag>_prob_*`` columns.

    With ``--geojson`` or ``--omecsv``, all probability prefix groups present
    in the registered CSVs are exported, one subfolder per group.
reg.name: reg

Each detected object is matched to its enclosing region and the region's class probabilities are added as region_<tag>_prob_* columns in the object CSVs.  Mutually exclusive with -c.
params.name: region_inference_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior object-level (cell-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder.  Each primary object is matched to its nearest secondary object within --radius-um and that object's class probabilities are added as object_<tag>_prob_* columns in the primary CSVs.  Mutually exclusive with -r.

When omitted, the bare default (region_prob_* / object_prob_*) is used; if the bare default already exists, the smallest free integer suffix is auto-picked (region_1_prob_*, object_2_prob_*, ...) unless --overwrite is given.

When -i/--wsi-dir is supplied, this value is treated as a fallback: each slide's MPP is read from the WSI metadata (OpenSlide / TiffSlide / tifffile / Aperio AppMag table) and used in preference; --spacing-um-px is only used for slides whose MPP cannot be read.

tcomp.help:
Compute triad-level neighborhood composition for WSInsight inference outputs.

    For every Delaunay triad (triangle of three cells), the k-hop neighboring
    triads are collected from the dual graph and the proportion of each triad
    type in that neighborhood is recorded, together with per-triad geometric
    features (area, perimeter, regularity, max edge length).

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      tcomp-outputs-csv/<slide_id>.csv   per-triad neighborhood composition
tcomp.name: tcomp

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and to resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during tcomp.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Maximum triad edge length (µm); triads whose longest edge exceeds this are dropped.
params.name: tcomp_max_edge

params.help: Number of hops that define the triad-level neighborhood radius (k-hop on the dual graph).
params.name: tcomp_k

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide tcomp outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Skip dual-graph construction and k-hop aggregation.  Output one row per Delaunay triad with geometry, cell types, triad type, and a ``centroid_region`` column (derived from per-vertex ``region_prob_*`` columns).  Much faster; no ``neighborhood_*`` columns are written.
params.name: no_neighborhood

import.help:
Import spatial-transcriptomics gene expression onto WSInsight cells.

 
For each sample in the sptx-list manifest:
  • map Xenium centroids (µm) onto the H&E via the ST2WSI transform,
  • match each cell to the nearest model-output detection,
  • write one AnnData with sparse expression + the matched detection link.

 
Output written to <results-dir>/:
  xenium-import/<sample_id>.h5ad
import.name: import

params.help: Directory (or image-list://) of H&E slides. Matched to a sample by stem == manifest sample_id; provides the exact target dimensions used by the elastic (B-spline) transform.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: A sptx-list:// manifest (path<TAB>sample_id per line). The path points at each Xenium sample directory; sample_id is the stable id used to match the H&E / model-output (Xenium filenames collide across runs).
params.name: sptx_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs (must contain model-outputs-csv/). xenium-import/ is written here.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Spatial-transcriptomics platform to import (xenium by default).
params.name: platform

params.help: ST2WSI coordinate transform: SIFT affine only, or affine + bUnwarpJ elastic B-spline (default; requires the H&E target dimensions).
params.name: transform

params.help: 'all' (full panel, Gene Expression features) or a comma-separated list of gene names to import.
params.name: genes

params.help: Maximum H&E-pixel distance for a cell↔detection match (0 = no cap; match_dist_px is always recorded so matches can be filtered later).
params.name: match_max_dist

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide imports.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: QC only: compute and report the cell↔detection match hit-rate and median match distance per sample, without reading expression or writing any h5ad. Use it to check a manifest pairing / registration before a full import.
params.name: dry_run
